text:
maria: FYI CI microbench failed on PR #20345, batch_fanout path. p50 +12% against main. ci/microbench/batch_fanout -> threshold diff
perf-bot: [CI] job ci/microbench/batch_fanout failed: https://ci/reports/20345
ash: ugh, any obvious stack?
maria: logs show kernel selector picking kernel_v3 more often after my change to the cost function. snippet: 
```
selector: chosen=kernel_v3 score=45.2 fallback=kernel_v1 score=48.6
metrics: p50=34.2ms (main=30.6ms)
```
jen: can you paste the perf flame or a sampled profile?
maria: attaching quick perf sample (small text): 
```
# profile top (self ms)
kernel_v3_execute 120ms
kv_batcher_wait 52ms
kernel_v1_execute 88ms
```
kevin: ran the microbench locally on my workstation (A100). Repro'd p50 delta ~+10% with kernel_v3. Command: `./tools/microbench --test batch_fanout --runs 100`
ashwin: ok let's bisect the selector change. I suspect commit 0a1b2c -> 0d4e5f (the autoselect rewrite).
maria: commit range: 0a1b2c..0d4e5f. If we bisect, we can see where the cost shift started.
kevin: quick diff shows key change in selector.cpp: cost = base + latency_weight * est_latency; weight bumped from 1.0 -> 1.3.
jen: that weight bump might amplify noise for short sequences and cause kernel_v3 to be favored even when it increases CPU ops.
ashwin: I'll run `git bisect` on CI shadow to confirm. plan: bisect -> identify offending commit -> try revert + run microbench in CI shadow.
maria: adding labels: rollback-candidate, rollout-blocker
perf-bot: triggered rerun on shadow: https://ci/shadow/20345-bisect (ETA ~20m) :hourglass:
kevin: while we wait, I ran a quick A/B: pinned kernel to v1 vs v3; results: 
```
Pinned kernel_v1: p50=30.5ms
Pinned kernel_v3: p50=34.1ms
```
ashwin: if bisect confirms, we should revert the autoselect weight bump and open hotfix PR. Revert patch will be minimal.
maria: +1. this blocks the rollout for the PR until hotfix is in.
jen: Also add a microbench unit test for selection decisions on short sequences so this doesn't regress silently.
kevin: noted, I'll sketch the test.
ashwin: shadow bisect finished: culprit = commit 0c3f9a2 "selector: increase latency weight to reduce kernel churn"
maria: confirmed locally -> reverting that commit in a branch removes the perf regression.
ashwin: opening revert PR now: #20378. tagging infra and oncall.
maria: thanks. leaving this thread pinned until revert merges. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy gate blocked for PR #20345 due to perf threshold violation.
perf-bot: will re-run microbench after revert merges and report back.
